Preserve the Drowned Causeway progression pattern: discovery -> access -> physical evidence.
Preserve the final anchor pattern: revelation -> open decision point -> world consequence.
Preserve the father mystery as an optional PERSONAL Side Saga rather than Main Saga resolution.
Preserve the unresolved marker-origin truth and the confirmed tidal/magnetic mechanism truth.
Preserve 15 total milestones, 3 per approved anchor.

minimal_repair_policy: Do not rewrite strong milestones unless required to keep the graph coherent.
Keep milestone keys stable when the milestone remains conceptually the same.
New keys are allowed only for milestones that are materially replaced.
Do not change the approved Saga goal, anchors, hidden truths, side sagas, or macro graph.
